en.topic_title: Po Leung Kuk charity appoints 16 ‘national security tutors’ under gov’t scheme
en.topic_summary:
The Po Leung Kuk, one of Hong Kong’s oldest and largest charities, has appointed 16 staff members to serve as “national security tutors” under a government scheme to promote national security awareness among its workforce, service users, and members of the public.







Senior service managers May Cheung and Sherman Cheung said at the Kuk’s “national security education team” launch ceremony that they volunteered to join as tutors, Ming Pao reported.



May Ch
